prompt: Explain machine learning to a beginner in 120 words. Include one practical example.

After six months, average bus journeys became 18 percent faster, passenger complaints fell, and ridership increased. The city plans to extend the programme to two more routes, while monitoring whether the improvements continue during peak hours.
